adjudication.reason: Complete 7-day and 30-day outcome coverage is available, but only two distinct recommendation dates exist per asset and Ethereum has no action variation. Certification-quality scoring would overstate the available independent evidence.

future_revisit_conditions: Accumulate additional independent recommendation dates prospectively.
Accumulate action diversity sufficient to evaluate the claimed action hierarchy.
Allow exact 90-day and 180-day endpoints to mature when useful, without treating maturity alone as sufficient certification evidence.
limitations: Bitcoin has only two distinct recommendation dates; the 12 stored rows must not be treated as 12 independent temporal observations.
Bitcoin contains only HOLD and WAIT actions, so the full governed action hierarchy cannot be tested.
Ethereum contains only WAIT recommendations, so within-asset action ordering cannot be evaluated.
Exact 90-day and 180-day outcomes are not yet mature.
Additional horizon maturity alone will not solve the two-date sample-size or Ethereum action-diversity limitations.
